title: Describe a successful or failed delivery
prompt: Declare `type Delivery` with exactly two shapes: `{ kind: "sent"; receipt: string }` for success and `{ kind: "failed"; reason: string }` for failure. Each tag must require its own field, and any other `kind` must be rejected. Only the type is checked. No runtime code is needed.
hints: Each shape has a required kind and one required text field.
A type with two optional fields permits a message missing both fields.
Define each shape, then combine the alternatives using the union operator.
typeChecks: __Extends<Delivery, { kind: "sent"; receipt: string } | { kind: "failed"; reason: string }>

wrongAnswers.misconception: Makes the matching field optional in both cases.

feedback: Try assigning a failed delivery with a reason, and a sent delivery missing its receipt. Only the first should fit.
